title: Agent fleet history: the build is an agentic pipeline
headline_insight: 3,224 commits from 2026-03-09 to 2026-07-22, 95.75% of them agent-authored -- the build itself is the product.
what_it_means: Over roughly four months the repo took 3,224 commits, of which 95.75% were agent-authored and 67.9% were co-authored by Claude. Output came in bursts: the busiest single day was 2026-05-26 with 275 commits.
how_to_read: The daily-commit series and the hour-by-weekday heat grid show when the fleet was active; weekly_agent_share tracks the agent-authored fraction week over week.
why_it_matters: It documents that this system was built by an autonomous agent fleet under a human director rather than hand-written, so the process is part of what is being shown.
caveat: Agent-authorship is inferred from commit author and co-author trailers and counts commits, not lines changed or reviewed quality.
